visual.name: bfusionResourceGapAnalysis
visual.description: Ranks roles by how soon each runs out of buffer: a demand-to-supply plot, utilisation against an alert level, and runway in periods.

dataRoles.name: resourceName
dataRoles.description: One row per value — Role, Skill, Team or Resource.

dataRoles.name: period
dataRoles.description: Bind a DATE column (e.g. DimDate[Date]) so the run-rate reads the latest period against the one before it. Runway needs at least two periods.

dataRoles.name: demand
dataRoles.description: Required. The filled dot on the demand-to-supply plot.

dataRoles.name: supply
dataRoles.description: Capacity or availability. The open dot. Without it there is no utilisation and no runway.

dataRoles.name: gap
dataRoles.description: Pre-2.0 single-measure binding, read only when Demand is unbound. Bind Demand and Supply instead.

dataRoles.name: tooltipFields
dataRoles.description: Extra measures to show on a row's tooltip card.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model
